messages:
kevin: Heads up — planning an unpin for the 'splitflow' model group tonight 02:00 UTC (canary -> staged rollout). Goal: unpin runtime 2.14.x for longseq perf fixes. Requirements: SDK 3.7.1 compat check, kv-cache warmup smoke, and no regressions in embeddings. Rollout plan: 10% (30m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100%. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Any immediate blockers?

anya: +1 on the timeline. I'll run the SDK smoke pass against canary infra at 01:30 UTC and post results.

mike: What are rollback triggers? CPU/mem OOMs, tail latency > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive p50 samples, or >3 client error spikes in 10m. If any trigger hits, we roll back to pinned runtime and open incident.

kevin: exact. Add: if we see prompt truncation/regression on eval set A (prompt-set-id: splitflow-regress-v2), abort.

deploybot: scheduled unpin request created by @kevin for 1718888888. pinlist note: splitflow-model-group -> UNPIN @ 1718888888. To cancel: /deploybot cancel 1718888888.

anya: Quick note about kv-cache warmup: run this command against canary tokens (runs ~3m):
```
$ infra-smoke run --group splitflow --canary --kv-warmup 3m
```
I'll paste results in 01:35 UTC.

taylor: I'll prep release notes blurb and user-facing note for the Console (keep it short):
"Runtime 2.14.5: longseq perf improvements for SplitFlow models; no API change. Contact support if you see increased latency."

sre-oncall: Nightshift coverage confirmed. I'll be on-call 01:45-04:30 UTC. Also will have quick rollback playbook pinned in #eng-oncall.

mike: SDK compat check expectations: run smoke against SDK 3.7.1 and 3.6.x fallback. If any 3.7.1-only failure, we need to gate and not proceed.

kevin: noted. Anya, can you also hit the embedding comparisons for a small sample (100 queries) to ensure no drift?

anya: Yep — embedding comparison will run after kv-warmup. I'll post a diff summary: mean cosine and 95th pct drift.

deploybot: deploy update: canary rollout will be enabled at 02:00 UTC with traffic policy: 10% initial, 50% at 02:40, 100% at 03:10 if green. Auto-rollback: enabled.

taylor: release notes draft pushed to the docs PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1246 — please review before 01:40 UTC.

mike: small request — add an obs metric watch on "splitflow.kv_warmup.failures" and an alert that pages on >0 after rollout start for 10m.

sre-oncall: added watch and pager. Also prepping a lightweight smoke script in case we need to manually validate after rollback.

kevin: thanks all. If we stay green on the 10% canary for 30m, I'll nudge deploybot to proceed to 50%. Will post final thumbs when I hit the go button. :thumbsup:

anya: first smoke run returning clean at 01:36 UTC — kv warmup OK, no OOM. Posting embedding diff in a sec. :eyes:

mike: sounds good. I'll keep an eye on latency dashboards during the canary.

taylor: noted, docs PR approved.

deploybot: reminder: chgewindow lock active for 1718888888 between 02:00-04:00 UTC.

kevin: final — all set. Proceeding to start canary at 02:00 unless someone yells stop. :slightly_smiling_face:
